On the button it is an arbitrary extra class and driving it would paint a button the design system does not draw. note: 412 recipes at 25 a page is 17 pages, so the summary reads the library specimen's own numbers. `onPageChange` writes back into `pageIndex` and `onPageSizeChange` into `pageSize`, so both arrows and the per-page selector move the bar on the plinth rather than only filling the log. THREE props decide whether the bar renders at all and they are not one vocabulary: `persistent` keeps it whatever the count, `multiPageOnly` renders it only past one page, and the default renders it whenever a page-size choice is still meaningful. `persistent` wins when both are set.
